::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** [after 1865]  
**Manuscript:** MS Humanities Research Center, University of Texas, Austin, Charlotte M. Yonge collection
:::

Dear Madam

I do not think Mr Clare resembles [Mr Keble](people/person_798.qmd) at all.[^1]  I certainly never should have consciously taken his portrait, I loved and honored him too much

yours truly
Charlotte M. Yonge

---

[^1]: Mr Clare is a character in CMY's *The Clever Woman of the Family* (1865).
